decision.justification: Selected 'best_single FT_rf' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.6101. Series context: trend strength 0.8687 and seasonal strength 0.1759; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.076); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.285.
